policy.monthlyBudgetHint: Total of the month's requests (Paris time).
policy.autoApproveHint: Allowed merchants only. 0 = always require approval.
policy.merchantAllowHint: Comma-separated. Empty = all, except blocked ones.
policy.perHourHint: Empty = unlimited. Slows down a runaway or manipulated agent.
policy.receiptHint: Empty = disabled. Past this delay, the agent is frozen.
policy.approvalsHint: Quorum of distinct approvers (Team plans and above).
policy.alwaysOn: Always active: high-risk categories blocked (gambling, money transfers, quasi-cash, securities) and human approval enforced on an unusual amount (more than 3 times the agent's median).
policy.freezeOnMismatch: Freeze the agent automatically on an amount or merchant mismatch
